programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: Inspired by Gerald Durrell's love of wildlife, Amanda and Alan design their first ever children's bedroom and visit Gerald's widow Lee for inspiration.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan show love to heart of the home, the kitchen. But with ivy growing out windows and roof on verge of collapse it's not an easy ride.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan's creative juices flow as they go all out with master bedroom, designing an Aphrodite themed suite for parents to reconnect on holiday.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: Taking on their most ambitious space to date, Amanda and Alan aim to turn land at front of house that's used as village car park into Mediterranean garden.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.sub-title: Chapter Seven - The Reading Room And Bathroom
programme.desc: Besties go head to head designing two separate spaces; Alan pays tribute to Greek gods with intellectual reading room whilst Amanda embraces AI for Greek themed bathroom.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: There's no holding back with last space, as Amanda and Alan go all out designing outdoor kitchen and reveal transformation of entire house with farewell party.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda gambles on a run-down townhouse in a forgotten village, hoping to revive it. She convinces Alan to join her in turning it into their dream boutique B&B.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan begin their first room design, tackling a dining room and foyer. Alan's dream of a reception area is dashed when Amanda proposes a stair cupboard.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan tackle the kitchen, a key space for entertaining. With a love for food, they aim to create the perfect social hub with a bold, traditional Spanish design.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda leads the bedroom design while Alan takes charge of the lounge. Tensions rise when Amanda decides to remove Alan's beloved curved arch that connects the two rooms.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda renovates the second guest bedroom, while Alan gets stuck with the windowless bathroom. They kick off the project by demolishing a wall that splits a window in half.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan face their biggest challenge yet: the courtyard. With a crumbling outbuilding and an overgrown vine, Alan struggles to see the potential.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Alan convinces Amanda to tone down her maximalist instincts for the final bedroom. They opt for an all-white, natural brick design, dubbing it a Balearic balm oasis.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan go all in for their final room, designing a lavish Moorish-gold bar. In Granada, a visit to a traditional tea house turns into more than they expected, with surprises beyond the tea.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programme.desc: Eva Longoria shows us around her adopted second hometown, Mexico City. This is where she met her husband, Pepe, and where they love to spend time with their son, Santi.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programme.desc: Eva travels to the edge of Mexico, to the jungles of Yucatan State, home of the ancient Maya. One of the great civilisations of Central America, the Maya thrived here until the arrival of the Spanish.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programme.desc: Eva travels to southern Mexico to experience the magic of Oaxaca. There she meets celebrity chef Celia Florian who's quesillo cheese with crickets and edible flowers is a delight to Eva.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programme.desc: The state of Nuevo Leon borders Texas, so this is a voyage of familiarity for Texas-born Eva. In the modern state capital Monterrey, Eva ventures to an innovative restaurant called Kohli.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programme.desc: Today, Eva heads out West to the fertile lands of Jalisco. There's a saying that 'Jalisco is Mexico and Mexico is Jalisco', because so much of what is seen as typically 'Mexican' all originated here.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programme.desc: Arriving at the port of Veracruz, Eva walks in the footsteps of her ancestor, Lorenzo Longoria, who arrived in this exact spot 400 years ago, just a century after the first conquistadors.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Naples is the third largest and most populous city in Italy. But its history has been tainted with underdog status from close association with Vesuvius, the mafia and poverty.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Situated in Lazio, the ancient city of Rome is often overlooked in the gastronomic department. Stanley Tucci meets up with an old friend, Claudia della Frattina, and they head out to explore.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: One of the world's best chefs, Massimo Bottura, drives Stanley to a premium parmigiano producer, who uses the milk of the white Modenese cows.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Milan is the capital of Lombardy. It's Italy's second biggest city and the business powerhouse. Stanley's first stop is the Duomo, the largest cathedral in Italy.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Tuscany is the birthplace of the Renaissance and world-class art, architecture and culture. It's also produced some of the finest wines and dishes in the history of Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Sicily is the Mediterranean's largest island and is known as God's Kitchen because of its rich soil. Michelin-starred chef Tony Lo Coco shows Stanley his signature dish, spaghetti alla bottarga.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits the Veneto. Once the centre of a world-trading empire, Tucci explores the ingenuity of the Venetians, who have embraced the unexpected delights and challenges of the lagoon.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits the region that made the dream of unified Italy a reality. Piedmont boasts refined French heritage of the Middle Ages, and is now spearheading a slow food revolution.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Umbria, nicknamed "The Green Heart of Italy"; with the highest consumption of pork per capita, Umbria is a carnivore's dream.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Tucci sets out to explore how Italian immigration has transformed the food scene in his adopted hometown of London. It's a culinary mecca where Italian food from every region gets a chance to shine.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Tucci discovers the history of beautiful and troubled Calabria, as well as the history of his own family; joined by his parents, he reflects on the inspiration people draw from Calabria.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Tucci visits the island of Sardinia, Italy, famous for its harsh, rugged landscape, crystal blue ocean, and passionately preserved traditions; Tucci learns how Sardinian food culture varies wildly.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Tucci visits Puglia, a region famous for its fragrant olive oil, beautiful vegetables, cheeses, and durum wheat; he discovers how the Pugliese own their past and embrace the future on their own terms.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Tucci visits the Italian Riviera famous for the glamor of Portofino; he tries Genoese pesto and discovers how Ligurians have learned to adapt to life in the difficult landscape.
